steps.en: Install poppler and fonts, then the GPU package in a clean Python 3.11 env
steps.zh: 装 poppler 和字体，在 Python 3.11 新环境里装 GPU 版

steps.en: Point it at a workspace folder and your PDFs
steps.zh: 指定一个工作区目录和你的 PDF

steps.en: Starts a local vLLM server with the olmOCR 7B vision model
steps.zh: 在本机起一个 vLLM 推理服务，加载 olmOCR 7B 视觉模型

steps.en: Queues pages in groups, renders each page and has the model read it in order
steps.zh: 把页面分组排队，逐页渲染成图，让模型按阅读顺序转写

steps.en: Retries failed pages, then writes Dolma JSONL plus one Markdown file per PDF
steps.zh: 失败页重试，写出 Dolma JSONL 和每个 PDF 的 Markdown

value.en: Scanned and multi-column PDFs become clean reading-order Markdown, ready for a training corpus
value.zh: 扫描件和多栏 PDF 变成按阅读顺序排好的干净 Markdown，可直接进训练语料

sources: https://github.com/allenai/olmocr#installation (poppler-utils + fonts; conda create -n olmocr python=3.11; pip install olmocr[gpu] --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128; 12 GB GPU RAM)
https://github.com/allenai/olmocr#using-an-inference-provider-or-external-server (spawns a local vLLM instance unless --server is given)
